Name: Mycology Mineralogy Marine Biology and More of Teyvat
Author: oclarina
Description:
Mycology and More of Teyvat is a mod for Stardew Valley that adds all sorts of forageables, minerals, artifacts, and a handful of other miscellaneous things from Genshin Impact to your SDV game.

For more information on the sorts of things you can find with this mod and where to find them, check out the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3690]Player's Guide[/url].

Additionally, while the title says Marine Biology, this mod only adds 2 actual fish. If you want a wider array of Genshin Impact fish in your game, I recommend otohimexoxo’s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19144]Fish of Teyvat[/url]!

If you want to grow some of these forageables and a bunch of other Genshin Impact crops on your farm, also check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]Botany of Teyvat[/url]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JfYqm9G.png[/img]
[b][color=#444444]Future Plans[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]New objects from future Genshin Impact areas[/*]
[*]A Genshin-themed cooking recipe mod[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iWf6x99.png[/img]
[b][color=#444444]Config Options[/color][/b]
[b]“Exclude from Perfection”[/b] - Decides whether shippable items and fish from Mycology and More of Teyvat are included as part of perfection.
[b]“Exclude Museum Donations”[/b] - Decides if Artifacts and Minerals from Mycology and More of Teyvat should be donated to the museum. [b][u]WARNING[/u][/b]: Some of the items in this mod may significantly delay museum completion, so if getting that stardrop quickly is important to you, I recommend you turn museum donations off. Also, turning museum donations off when you’ve already donated some may leave some objects floating in the void and cause museum rewards to be triggered early, so it’s not recommended, but is ultimately harmless.
[b]"Remove Museum Room" [/b]- For most cases, this should match "Exclude Museum Donations." If you'd like to still have the room while not donating any items, or you have another mod that adds museum space and don't want MMMMoT's museum room, then they can mismatch.
[b]"Remove Fish of Teyvat Overlaps" [/b]- If checked while Fish of Teyvat is installed, removes the MMMMoT versions of Beryl Conch, Lumitoile, Sango Pearl, Starconch, and Tidalga from the game. Does nothing if Fish of Teyvat isn't installed.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d9coSGl.png[/img]
[b][color=#444444]Compatibility[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]No known incompatibilities! If anything comes up, let me know so I can try to figure it out.[/*]
[*]If you have both BoT and MMMMoT, overlapping items should work as intended in both mods, so you can either forage or grow your Sweet Flowers.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dULKHJf.png[/img]
[b][color=#444444]Known Issues[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]If you have SVE, the MMMMoT museum wing will not have matching glass cases.[/*]
[*]Starshrooms, Crystal Marrow, and Candlecap Mushrooms will spawn every few seconds after you enter a floor of the mines or Volcano Dungeon. This is intentional behavior, as it’s the only way I could get modded items to spawn in the mines.[/*]
[/list]
